name: antivirus-renewal-scam
description: A fake security-software renewal: the brand's name on an unrelated domain, a subscription said to be scheduled for deactivation, and a link to update billing on a host the brand does not own. The commonest English lure in public phishing corpora, and one that reads word for word like the genuine notice it copies.

email.subject: Final notice: your Norton 360 renewal payment failed
email.bodyText:
PROTECTION EXPIRING TODAY

Dear Customer,

Your Norton 360 subscription is scheduled for deactivation today because we were unable to process your renewal payment.

We tried to charge your card three times. To keep your devices protected, please update your billing information now.

Update Payment Now

If you have already updated your payment details, please disregard this message.

Ref: KQ-551920
